vc_checking.summary: All three current manual witnesses are semantically proofable. The two general return witnesses are the standard xizi_dllseg nil/cons classification pair: first <> sentinel rules out nil and permits reclosing xizi_dll, while first = sentinel rules out every nonempty segment and leaves the nil segment unchanged. The derived nil_case witness chooses nodes_general = nil, preserves the input xizi_dll resource as the general-call precondition, and establishes the wand by forwarding the successful nil return branch to the nil_case postcondition; its impossible nonnil branch is discharged by nil <> nil. No annotation/spec repair and no group-local case_lib helper are required.

natural_language_analysis.summary: The two return VCs share a segment-case proof family. The derived-spec VC has a different wand-adjunction proof shape, so it is kept in a separate bounded group even though all three belong to the same C function.
